method: Official GitHub Contributors rendered DOM; All / Commits / current default branch. Present-account ranks are read directly from explicit account cards. Absence requires complete displayed-list traversal. Previous verified ranks are retained when a graph error prevents the check or repeated graph failures stop further attempts.
limitations: GitHub later returned Graph could not be rendered / There was an error generating this graph across multiple repositories; limited reloads did not resolve it.
Graph generation failure does not establish contributor absence. Retained rank rows keep their previous verification source and date.
Graph commit counts are a separate displayed GitHub metric; they are not substituted for author-history counts or merged PR counts.
